verdicts.title: Tropical Teichmuller and Siegel spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, we present a unified study of the moduli space of tropical curves and Outer space which we link via period maps to the moduli space of tropical abelian varieties and the space of positive definite quadratic forms. Our work is a first step towards exhibiting Outer space and the space of positive definite quadratic forms as analogues of Teichmüller space and Siegel space, respectively, in tropical geometry. verdicts.title: The number of vertices of a tropical curve is bounded by its area
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the notion of tropical area of a tropical curve defined in an open subset of $\mathbb R^n$. We prove that the number of vertices of a tropical curve is bounded by the area of the curve. The approach is totally elementary yet tricky. Our proof employs ideas from intersection theory in algebraic geometry. The result can be interpreted as the fact that the moduli space of tropical curves with bounded area is of finite type.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract bounds the number of vertices of a tropical curve by its area and discusses moduli of tropical curves, with no mention of Jacobian rank, k-CNF formulas, or resolution proof complexity.
